title: Ben 10: Alien Force
description: Five years later, 15-year-old Ben Tennyson chooses to once again put on the Omnitrix and discovers that it has reconfigured his Dna and can now transform him into 10 brand new aliens. Joined by his super-powered cousin Gwen Tennyson and his equally powerful former enemy Kevin Levin, Ben is on a mission to find his missing Grandpa Max. In order to save his Grandpa, Ben must defeat the evil Dnaliens, a powerful alien race intent on destroying the galaxy, starting with planet Earth.

episodes.title: S1-E8What Are Little Girls Made Of?

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Ben discovers that the Forever Knights are trading weapons with the DNAliens, while at the same time, Grandpa Max has mysteriously gone missing. He decides to return the Omnitrix on his wrist and go hero once again.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Ben, Gwen, and Kevin follow a lead that takes them to a secret base in the desert. There they hope to find Grandpa Max but instead find a Highbreed spaceship with a giant cannon.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Gwen discovers that Grandpa Max's badge is able to signal other Plumbers. However, by using it, they meet up with a familiar face, a pyronite.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Kevin shatters Ben and Gwen's trust when he steals the Rust Bucket to sell for alien technology on the black market.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Grandpa Max leaves Ben a series of instructions to contact a team of heroes. Things go the wrong direction when they soon find them.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Gwen's older brother, Ken, is suddenly missing. As they look, they encounter a surprise leading to a shocking secret from the DNAliens.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: While Ben has a date with Julie, it is soon ruined when an alien named Ship makes trouble at the local fair.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: When Ben and Gwen learn that their grandmother Verdona is an alien being, Verdona insists that Gwen should come along with her to her home planet and improve her abilities. With this, Gwen is faced with a difficult decision between a human and alien life.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: When Ben stands up to Cash and JT, they soon discover a robotic gauntlet from Kevin's vehicle. With it, Cash decides to get back on Ben, although this time, it's more than just a joke.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: A time experiment in the 1950s sends a bizarre monster to Ben's time. Now Ben, Gwen, and Kevin must team up with Paradox, a time traveling hero, to face off against the unstoppable creature.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: The Forever Knights secure a weapon in hopes of aiding them slay a dragon they have held captive.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Freelance young Plumbers mistake Ben and his team as a threat.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: An alien emperor plans to destroy the planet Earth for kidnapping his daughter. In order to save the planet, Ben must uncover the secrets of Alien X.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 2 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: A new villain comes into town, his name is Darkstar, he commits some crimes and gets the team's attention fast

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 2 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: During a battle Ben and an alien commander are teleported to a distant world. They must put their differences aside if they're going to have any chance of finding a way to return to Earth.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: An alien impersonates Ben with hopes of using his Omnitrix to annihilate him.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 2 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Kevin asks Gwen to the school dance; Ben fears he's losing control of the Omnitrix.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 2 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Cooper is kidnapped by the DNAliens, who want him to build a mystery arch.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 2 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: To find and destroy the alien dragon species, the Forever Knights capture Ship to control a starship they built out of alien technology to locate their homeworld and destroy them.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 2 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: When Ben's parents discover his ability to turn into aliens, they forbid him from using the Omnitrix and later ground him from using it again. Eventually Gwen is grounded too leaving Kevin to stop the DNAliens.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 2 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: After Gwen receives an S.O.S. from Helen, Ben must go into the Null Void to save her and Manny. Once there, he must find The Wrench in order to stop D'Void, who happens to be Ben's old enemy Dr. Animo

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 2 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Ben and the gang rescue a runaway prisoner of the DNAliens.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 2 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: The gang helps the prince of the arachna-chimps regain power

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 2 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Ben cares for a baby monster and helps locate its parents before the DNAliens find it.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 2 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Ben, Gwen and Kevin gather their allies to counter the threat of the incoming Highbreed fleet. Azmuth reveals a secret about the Omnitrix.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 2 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Ben goes to the HighBreeds' world in an attempt to stop their attack on Earth.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 3 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Vilgax, after conquering 10 planets, comes to Earth to destroy Ben.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 3 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Ben, Gwen and Kevin race to collect the Omnitrix's missing forms and make it to the battle with Vilgax on time. Meanwhile, Kevin discovers that his new transformation has some benefits.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 3 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Ben, Gwen and Kevin discover that Vulkanus is planning to drill the center of the Earth and drop a bomb into the hole. Destroying the planet.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 3 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: A species of goat-like aliens comes to Earth for a popcorn festival. Ben, Gwen, and Kevin have a big problem when one of the aliens eats meat and turns into a monster.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 3 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: An alien named Probity seeks help from Ben to stop the on-going war on her home planet.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 3 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Ship's owner decides he wants him back and hires some repo men to retrieve him. Ben and Kevin go to court to take care of things legally, leaving Gwen and Julie to face the repo men.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 3 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: A bounty hunter tries to remove the Omnitrix from Ben.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 3 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: A series of earthquakes awakens a HighBreed officer who has been hibernating deep under the earth’s surface. He believes the HighBreed have lost the war and activates a fail safe device that is programmed to destroy. Ben must now work together with Gwen and Kevin not only to save Grandpa Max, but also the world from this "giant" problem.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 3 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Kevin is beginning to lose all hope that he will someday return to his human self. He then meets a girl who doesn't seem to mind the form he is in. Kevin finds himself under her spell, quite literally, as Charmcaster has come back to exact revenge on Ben and Gwen. Kevin, under Charmcaster's spell, has no choice but to obey his master and destroy Ben and Gwen.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 3 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Vilgax promises Ghostfreak to spring him out of prison as long as he tells him the secrets of the Omnitrix, but when Ghostfreak betrays him and turns his people into his minions, Vilgax comes to Earth and asks for Ben, Gwen and Kevin's help to get rid of Ghostfreak.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 3 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Kevin makes a temporary truce with Darkstar to retrieve an artifact that will return them into their former selves.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 3 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Ben, Kevin and Gwen come across an alien box that can forms into a robotic version of whatever it sees. It power becomes a liability when the Vreedle brothers decide to take the box for themselves.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 3 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Zaw-Veenull asks Ben to deliver Prince Tiffin to Jarret in order to keep peace between the two species. Shortly, after their trip in space, the Omnitrix malfunctions and turns Ben into an Appoplexian named Rath who wants to fight anything that breathes.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 3 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: The Omnitrix transports Ben, Gwen, and Kevin to a planet called Primus, which turns out to have been created by Azmuth. They must stop Vilgax from stopping the Omnitrix at its source.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 3 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Despite being warned by Paradox, Gwen travels back in time to prevent the accident that turned Kevin into a monster from ever happening. Gwen returns to the present only to find that her time traveling caused a series of events that led to Hex ruling the world.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 3 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: While sick, Ben is visited by old friend Tetrax, who demands that Ben hand over Chromastone.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 3 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: The Plumber's Helpers are called upon by Grandpa Max to rescue him from an abandoned space station where he's being attacked by Ben! The team must now find a way to work together as they try to save Max, stop Ben, and keep the space station from crashing to Earth.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 3 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Kevin returns home to find his house ransacked, so he enlists Ben and Gwen's help to find out who did it and why. They soon cross paths with Ragnarok, a deadly criminal who recently broke free from the Null Void and is in search of a special key. Kevin is intent on stopping Ragnarok from obtaining the special key, especially after he learns the truth about Ragnarok and his father.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 3 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Albedo has stolen the Ultimatrix from Azmuth and has used it to kidnap Gwen and Kevin. Ben goes to face Albedo and rescue his friends when he quickly discovers that Albedo has been working in conjunction with Vilgax. Ben is defeated by the pair and gives up the Omnitrix to save himself and his friends.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10: Alien Force Season 3 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Powerless, Ben goes aboard Vilgax's ship and faces off with Vilgax to stop his invasion of Earth in their final battle. Albedo gives Ben the Ultimatrix and Ben gets his old aliens and their evolved forms.
